gates.reason: Devin considered the R14 review questions of the 2026-09-15 merge batch together and ruled to keep the asset as delivered. The rights evidence stands as recorded by the worker; no further clearance is pursued. Decision relayed and recorded by the producer.
gates.claim: ASSET_PLAN.md:117 lists 'Pexels, Pixabay (browsable without login)' as sources for hands shuffling cards; ASSET_PLAN.md:109-122 treats free stock as browsable without login.
gates.finding_on_plan_claim: Partly false for the agent on 2026-09-15. Pixabay search pages were browsable but held no suitable shuffling clip. Pexels individual video pages were not browsable by the agent (HTTP 403; Cloudflare verification interstitial). Mixkit, which the plan did not name, was browsable without login and supplied all three candidates.

acquisition_evidence.status: rank 1 acquired 2026-09-15; rights recorded, NOT cleared. R14 stays open.
acquisition_evidence.approved_by: Devin, 2026-09-15, relayed via the B-roll Scouting Manager (session vb-bf); acquisition only, not release.
acquisition_evidence.access_path_observed: The approved download URL returned the Mixkit download modal (HTML, 2738 bytes) naming the asset URL; the bytes were fetched from that URL. No login, payment, CAPTCHA, bot check or terms click-through was encountered or bypassed. The no-login download path is now exercised, not merely observed.
acquisition_evidence.watermark_check: No watermark, caption, logo or bug in any of the three full-resolution frames inspected (5.0 s, 10.5 s, 16.0 s). The preview-page assumption is now confirmed on the delivered original.
acquisition_evidence.audio_check: ffprobe shows no audio stream at all, so the 'narration' risk is closed: there is no audio to clear.
acquisition_evidence.casino_layout_confirmed: Yes, and slightly stronger than scouting recorded. The printed casino felt is visible throughout the selected 5.0-16.0 s segment: a large yellow numeral '10' across the top edge, curved and straight white betting lines, and — new at the 16.0 s out point — partial white upside-down lettering reading '...EX...' at the right edge, consistent with a 'TEXAS HOLD'EM' table layout. Scouting had noted felt lettering only at 19.1 s, outside the cut; it is in fact inside the cut. No brand name, casino name, or logo was identified at full resolution.
acquisition_evidence.third_party_designs_at_full_resolution: Card backs are a bold abstract black-and-white geometric pattern with no legible brand, maker's mark or text (checked at 1920x1080 at 5.0 s and 10.5 s). Card faces are never shown in the selected segment. The felt layout is a generic poker/Texas Hold'em betting diagram. Whether these unbranded third-party designs need clearance under Mixkit User Terms s.13 is still a judgement call, not an evidence question.

gates.license_evidence_quality: The license modal text was read directly from the rendered page DOM (class license-modal__inner) on 2026-09-15. The User Terms limits come from a WebFetch model summary of https://mixkit.co/terms/ (reported 'last revised October 2, 2025') and were not read verbatim.
review_questions: Taste (sharpened after acquisition): the printed casino felt is more present in the cut than scouting implied — a yellow '10', white betting lines throughout, and partial 'TEXAS HOLD'EM'-style lettering entering frame at the 16.0 s out point. Is that acceptable for a family card-game (War) segment, or should the cut end earlier (about 14.5 s, before the lettering clears the fingers), or should the plain-felt rank 2 (100398) be acquired instead despite its 0.5 s handles and flourish-style motion?
Legal risk: are the visible card-back pattern and table-layout design (unbranded third-party components under Mixkit User Terms s.13) acceptable without further clearance?
Evidence: is the WebFetch summary of the Mixkit User Terms sufficient, or should the Terms be read verbatim before release?

review_questions_resolved.question: Boundary: approve the batched download of rank 1 Full HD (70.51 MB), or all three (173.39 MB)?
review_questions_resolved.resolution: Devin approved rank 1 only on 2026-09-15. Acquired; ranks 2 and 3 were not downloaded. This question is closed.

gates.decision: Approved: keep the asset. Rights risk accepted as documented.
